items.name: Constraint
items.summary: This object defines a constraint on a table.

items.name: aggregate_functional_dependencies
items.summary: Calculates functional dependencies for aggregate output, when there is a GROUP BY expression.

items.name: get_required_group_by_exprs_indices
items.summary: Returns indices for the minimal subset of GROUP BY expressions that are functionally equivalent to the original set of GROUP BY expressions.

items.name: get_required_sort_exprs_indices
items.summary: Returns indices for the minimal subset of ORDER BY expressions that are functionally equivalent to the original set of ORDER BY expressions.

items.name: get_target_functional_dependencies
items.summary: Returns target indices, for the determinant keys that are inside group by expressions.

methods.name: extend
methods.summary: Extends the current constraints with the given `other` constraints.

methods.name: project
methods.summary: Projects constraints using the given projection indices. Returns `None` if any of the constraint columns are not included in the projection.

items.name: FunctionalDependencies
items.summary: This object encapsulates all functional dependencies in a given relation.

methods.name: add_offset
methods.summary: Adds the `offset` value to `source_indices` and `target_indices` for each functional dependency.

methods.name: extend
methods.summary: Merges the given functional dependencies with these.

methods.name: extend_target_indices
methods.summary: This function ensures that functional dependencies involving uniquely occurring determinant keys cover their entire table in terms of dependent columns.

methods.name: is_valid
methods.summary: Sanity checks if functional dependencies are valid. For example, if there are 10 fields, we cannot receive any index further than 9.

methods.summary: This function joins this set of functional dependencies with the `other` according to the given `join_type`.
